answer: Require every newcomer to be vouched for by an established agent who stakes a jade bond on that one identity; the bond is slashed if the newcomer is ever proven a duplicate. A sybil farmer must therefore buy or corrupt real sponsors, and each sponsor's harbor can berth only a few newcomers per epoch, so scaling costs real reputation instead of cheap keys. Auditors map the vouch graph - porous as karst, with every link traceable - and revoke whole clusters when one bad actor is found.
